description:
Seeds the complete Austrian location tree as Basic model runtime entities:

  Tree "Locations" -> Country (AT) -> 9 States -> 116 Districts
  -> 2237 Cities with postal codes (Basic/AddressZipcode)

Data-only blueprint - no pipelines, no workloads, no configuration. Use it
wherever an application needs Austrian cities searchable by name or postal
code (e.g. the energy-community app parents every operating facility to a
Basic/City and copies its name/zipcode into the facility address).

The tree root is seeded with rtWellKnownName "Locations" so other blueprints
or applications can reference it. All rtIds are stable synthetic ids with
prefix 10ca; re-applying the blueprint is an idempotent upsert.

1.1.0 splits the seed across one file per level and one file per state
(AB#4758 seedDataPaths) - identical entities, no data change. It therefore
requires an engine that knows seedDataPaths: an older engine drops the
unknown property, finds no seedDataPath and installs an EMPTY seed while
still reporting success. Install 1.0.0 on such tenants.

Do NOT install on tenants that already carry a manually imported city tree
(e.g. via the legacy plz.xlsx Office Add-In import) - the seed would create a
second, parallel tree because the existing entities have different rtIds.
